args.title: Sphere 2027 Individual HDHP and PPO — Archived Comparison
args.body:
# Sphere 2027 Individual HDHP and PPO — Archived Comparison

Archived January 1, 2028.

## Terms

| Feature | Individual HDHP | Individual PPO |
|---|---:|---:|
| Premium per biweekly paycheck | $98 | $164 |
| Annual premium over 26 paychecks | $2,548 | $4,264 |
| Deductible | $2,300 | $750 |
| Coinsurance after deductible | 10% | 20% |
| Preventive care | Fully covered | Fully covered |
| HSA eligibility | Eligible | Not eligible |
| Employer HSA funding | $900, paid as four $225 deposits in January, April, July, and October | None stated; plan was not HSA-eligible |

## Enrollment deadline

Sphere’s 2027 benefits enrollment deadline was October 23, 2026, at 5:00 PM Eastern. Elections submitted during open enrollment applied to the 2027 plan year and generally could not be changed after the deadline without a qualifying life event.

## Neutral comparison

The HDHP had the lower payroll premium, a higher deductible, lower post-deductible coinsurance, and HSA eligibility with employer funding. The PPO had the higher payroll premium and lower deductible, higher post-deductible coinsurance, and no HSA eligibility.

This document is an archival comparison of posted 2027 terms and the enrollment deadline. It does not make or record a plan election.
